keyEvents.text: Delay in match because of an injury Liam Morrison (Queens Park Rangers).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Kwame Poku (Queens Park Rangers) is shown the yellow card.

Goal! Norwich City 0, Queens Park Rangers 1. Harvey Vale (Queens Park Rangers) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Kealey Adamson following a fast break.
Harry Darling (Norwich City) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Norwich City. Jovon Makama replaces Paris Maghoma.
Goal! Norwich City 1, Queens Park Rangers 1. Anthony Musaba (Norwich City) right footed shot from the left side of the box to the high centre of the goal. Assisted by Mathias Kvistgaarden.
Substitution, Queens Park Rangers. Ilias Chair replaces Koki Saito.
Substitution, Queens Park Rangers. Richard Kone replaces Rumarn Burrell.
Substitution, Norwich City. Lucien Mahovo replaces Anthony Musaba.
Substitution, Norwich City. Kenny McLean replaces Jacob Wright.
Substitution, Norwich City. Anis Ben Slimane replaces Mathias Kvistgaarden.
Substitution, Queens Park Rangers. Karamoko Dembélé replaces Kwame Poku.
Substitution, Queens Park Rangers. Jake Clarke-Salter replaces Liam Morrison.
Substitution, Norwich City. Oscar Schwartau replaces Darlin Yongwa.
